text: {"summary":"Example Trading LLC (about 220 staff across Dubai head office, Abu Dhabi branch and Jebel Ali warehouse) wants to replace email and paper leave requests and an HR Excel workbook with an online leave management solution. Employees request leave, managers decide with sight of their team's calendar, HR keeps balances correct, and HR and finance receive monthly reports and a payroll export. This first draft covers objectives, stakeholders, functional and non-functional requirements, business rules, user stories, assumptions, dependencies and open questions. Several points are unresolved and need answers before the requirements can be settled: the manager decision deadline (2 or 5 working days), when HR approval is also needed, entitlement and day-counting rules, the source of shift patterns, the account type for warehouse staff, and the report and payroll cut-off details.
